title: Exception-Based Finally Resource Leak
pattern: Attempting to release a resource in a `finally` block when the allocation itself is done in the `try` block and could have thrown.
why_bad: Secondary crashes. The deallocation code crashes on null or uninitialized state, swallowing the original allocation error.
detection: Variable definitions initialized within a `try` block, and deallocated in `finally`, without validating allocation success.
counterexample: Safe cleanup libraries where the deallocator is guaranteed to be a no-op on null inputs.
fix: Allocate before entering the try block, or use RAII (`Drop` in Rust) to automatically clean up.
source: Andrew Hunt & David Thomas, *The Pragmatic Programmer*, Chapter 5.
